清晰术虽然无法在召唤师峡谷中直接选用，但可以通过启封的秘籍获得。
致命一击只会对目标英雄的生命值降至40%以下后造成的伤害生效。
无法施法时，标记和冲刺都无法使用。（受到缚地或禁锢效果时，无法使用冲刺，但仍可使用标记。）
防御塔处于强化状态时，如果它对敌方英雄完成最后一击或参与击杀，你会像亲自造成了该伤害一样获得击杀或助攻。这不适用于击杀小兵。
使用者死亡时，守护者无法触发。
在无法使用守卫的模式中，深入守卫会替换为可怖纪念品。
治疗术与复苏搭配时，会额外提供随等级变化的治疗量；生命值低于最大生命值的40%时，这一治疗量会提高至另一随等级变化的数值。
调节提供的属性提升并非全部计为额外护甲或魔法抗性。（基础护甲和魔法抗性提高的3%不计为额外护甲或魔法抗性；鼠标悬停在护甲或魔法抗性属性上时，提示面板中也不会将其显示为基础护甲或魔法抗性的提升。因此，提示中的数值无法正确相加。）（由于游戏中没有任何按基础护甲或基础魔法抗性计算的比例效果，无法判断这3%的基础抗性属性加成是否计为基础护甲或魔法抗性。类似情况下，过度生长提供的属性会计为基础属性。）
英雄回城时，艾黎也会现身并播放回城动画。（在此期间，艾黎拥有独立的1350单位视野半径。如果玩家紧贴草丛回城并朝向特定方向，艾黎偶尔能看到草丛内部。）
公理秘术会影响使用者终极技能被动效果造成的伤害。（虽然瑞兹的终极技能曲境折跃的被动效果会造成伤害，但它似乎不会使瑞兹的 EQ〔法术涌动＋超负荷〕伤害提高12%或8%。）
黑暗收割会被分身触发，但不会被僵尸触发。
余震造成范围伤害，且该伤害还带有触发型伤害标签，因此会施加技能效果。
注意：如果附近有两个攻城小兵，晋升会作用于距离最近的那个，无论它是否已经被晋升。这可能导致晋升被浪费在已晋升的攻城小兵身上。
【防御塔奖励】全队奖励会发放给队伍中的所有英雄。
如果定身效果施加给免疫位移的目标，冰川增幅不会触发。
惩戒及其升级形态造成触发型伤害，因此不会触发技能效果。
作为参考，冲击指示器的半径为175单位。
在无法使用守卫的模式中，每层效果改为永久提供3点召唤师技能急速，最多提供54点。
攻击守卫或野区植物时，不会消耗迅捷步法。

texts: 天启者 Q 心灵烈焰会造成减速和范围伤害，因此站在小兵后方或射程之外，避免被命中。如果被天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 Q 火圈命中，在它片刻后爆炸前走出范围。天启者 W 坚定不移连接到你时，在被禁锢前拉开距离，打断连接。

刀锋之影射程较短，不要先手上前，用刀锋之影 W 斩草除根消耗对方血量。不要频繁施放 W，以免耗掉留给击杀机会的法力。
把握十足时，用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再近距离命中刀锋之影 W 斩草除根的去程和回程两段伤害，随后普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末。想快速打出伤害时，先施放刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，在其即将返回时用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，接普攻。
趁天启者 W 坚定不移处于冷却时进场，被禁锢的风险更低。等天启者 E 鼓舞的移速加成和天启者 R 梵咒强化后 E 的护盾结束，再用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交拉近距离。尽可能留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭，以便撤离时使用。

等天启者 W 坚定不移进入冷却，且天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 E 护盾结束后再进场。选定一名目标集中施放技能；难以正面进场时，用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道绕侧面攻击后排。尽可能留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭，以便撤离时使用。

在核心装备之间穿插购买死刑宣告，应对解脱者 W 弑君突刺的回复。刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末的流血会持续一段时间，容易维持重伤效果。应对解脱者主要伤害要堆魔抗，而不是护甲。

躲开解脱者 E 潜掠 / 压制的第二段锁链，并等解脱者 W 弑君突刺也进入冷却后再进场。抓住这个空档，用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，或用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道拉近距离。刀锋之影 E 刺客之道可能被锁链打断，因此要留到躲开锁链后再用；刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭则留作撤离手段。

解脱者用 E 潜掠 / 压制进场后、用 W 弑君突刺回复之前，是他最弱的时候，要和队友一起集火。亲自进场时，等敌方控制技能交给队友后，用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道绕侧面，集中技能攻击一名目标。最好留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭的隐身效果，以便撤离时使用。

等天启者 W 坚定不移交掉，在她上前补刀时用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近。如果天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 E 护盾已经开启，就等护盾持续时间结束再进场。开始换血后，用普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末，再撤出。
刀锋之影手短，先别主动上前，用刀锋之影 W 斩草除根消耗血量。别频繁使用 W，以免失去击杀时需要的法力值。
有把握命中时，先用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再从近处让刀锋之影 W 斩草除根的去程和回程都命中，接普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末。需要快速打出时，先扔刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，在回程前一刻用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再接普攻。
在天启者 W 坚定不移交掉后的空档进场，被禁锢留住的风险更小。等天启者 E 鼓舞的移速加成和天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 E 护盾结束，再用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交拉近距离。尽量留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭用于撤离。
学会刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭后，爆发和游走能力增强。推线后用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道翻墙，支援边路。游戏拖得越久，刀锋之影的影响力越低，优势时要持续施压。
等天启者 W 坚定不移交掉、天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 E 护盾结束后再进场。选定一名目标集中使用技能；正面难以进场时，用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道绕到侧面，攻击后排。尽量在撤离时使用刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭。
解脱者 E 潜掠 / 强掳的第一段突进没有伤害，但被后续锁链命中会被击飞并遭到连击。刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交或刀锋之影 E 刺客之道要留到躲锁链时使用，而不是在第一段突进时使用。解脱者 Q 锁链鞭击的交叉点会延迟爆炸，即使只被第一段擦到，也要立刻离开。
为应对解脱者 W 弑君突刺的回复，在核心装备之间补出死刑宣告。刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末的流血伤害会持续生效，容易维持重伤。应对解脱者主要伤害需要的是魔抗，不是护甲。
解脱者上前补刀时，用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，打一次短换血。近距离让刀锋之影 W 斩草除根的两段都命中，再用普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末，然后撤出。如果解脱者 W 弑君突刺还在，注意不要只把他血量打低却迟迟不收掉。
刀锋之影 W 斩草除根耗蓝较多，不要频繁使用。推完线后，确认视野再游走。
有把握命中时，先用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再从近处扔出刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，让去程和回程都命中，接一记普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末的流血。需要快速打出时，先扔刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，在回程前一刻用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再打普攻。
躲开解脱者 E 潜掠 / 强掳的第二段锁链，且解脱者 W 弑君突刺也交掉时，就是进场机会。趁机用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，或用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道拉近距离。刀锋之影 E 刺客之道可能被锁链打断，因此要留到躲开锁链后使用；刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭则留作撤离手段。
学会刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭后，游走和爆发能力增强，用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道在边路形成人数优势。游戏拖得越久，刀锋之影的影响力越低，优势时要持续施压。
解脱者用解脱者 E 潜掠 / 强掳进场后、尚未用解脱者 W 弑君突刺回复前最脆弱，要和队友集火。自己进场时，等对方把控制技能交给队友，再用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道绕到侧面，对一名目标集中使用技能。留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭的隐身用于撤离更安全。

texts: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, you are vulnerable to follow-up damage. If the first spell hits, immediately reposition with LeBlanc W Distortion to dodge the second. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on maximum health, so leave its marked area.
Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance.

Right after Hwei uses E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. Deal a quick burst of damage, check which counterattack spells Hwei still has, then return with the W recast.

While Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, do not initiate with LeBlanc W Distortion. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a fight in a side lane or the jungle. If you cannot push the lane, do not leave.
If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and stay in range to keep the chain connected.

Hwei has no mobility spell, so enter with LeBlanc W Distortion while Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. If E is still available, wait: it can turn back your engage or root you. Before going in, make sure the W return point is safe.

Early on, use magic resistance to withstand Hwei's magic damage and take short trades. Later, the enemy's magic resistance and vision can leave you open to a counterattack if you cannot get a kill in one burst, so prioritize pick opportunities.

Do not initiate from the front. Once the fight starts and the enemy focuses on your tank, approach from the side. When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, use LeBlanc W Distortion to reach one backline target, then return with the W recast. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch an enemy walking alone through an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

The chain Sylas throws after the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is the dangerous part. Save LeBlanc W Distortion to dodge it, and move out of the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash immediately. A low-health Sylas can heal substantially with Sylas W Kingslayer, so do not delay the finishing blow.
Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Take a short trade after Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is used and before it comes back. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion, watch whether Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, then return with the LeBlanc W Distortion recast.
Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice before roaming. If you cannot push the lane, do not leave.

When Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the chain connected. As the root takes hold, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark. Check that your return point is safe before going in, and recast LeBlanc W Distortion in time to return.

After dodging the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, you have an opening to engage before that spell comes back. If Sylas W Kingslayer is also available, he may have another way to get out, so watch for it as you go in with LeBlanc W Distortion. Get out before the LeBlanc W Distortion return window expires.
Later, avoid forced engages: once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, killing them in one burst becomes harder.

Right after Sylas jumps in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic and kill him before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. When engaging yourself, wait until the fight starts, target one backline enemy from the side, then get out with LeBlanc W Distortion. Also look for a chance to catch an enemy walking alone through an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

When the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence appears, stay out of its marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch where Ekko Q Timewinder travels and move out of its return path too. If Ekko's afterimage is visible, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not chase recklessly even if his health is low.
Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and take a short trade right after Ekko E Phase Dive is used. If Ekko R Chronobreak is down too, look for a chance to close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Before going in, check that the LeBlanc W Distortion return point is safe.

Avoid trading directly until the enemy's key spells are down. Repeat short trades by going in with LeBlanc W Distortion and recasting it to return. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a fight in a side lane or the jungle. If you cannot push the lane, do not leave.

For a safe short trade, apply the mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, trigger it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If Ekko E Phase Dive is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep it connected. As the root takes hold, follow with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. To attempt another root, use LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

Avoid the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and engage after Ekko E Phase Dive is used. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not chase deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. While both mobility spells are down, approach with LeBlanc W Distortion and connect LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

Early on, build magic resistance and take short trades only when the enemy's key spells are down. Later, avoid forced engages because you may face a counterattack if you cannot get a kill in one burst.

Do not enter from the front first. Once the fight starts and the enemy focuses on your tank, pick a target and engage from the side. Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, look to root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic, then get out with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to root and pick off an enemy walking alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

If the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits, back away until the bleed ends so the second dagger misses. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she cannot be targeted, so use your finishing spell after it ends. Do not walk alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is ready.

Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first and get health as well. If fights drag on because of healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate, consider healing reduction next.

Take a short trade only right after Naafiri's key mobility spell is used. Apply a mark with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, trigger it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return before she can counterattack. Check that your return point is safe before going in.

Naafiri is melee, so poke and farm from behind your minion line. Do not give her an opening to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. After Naafiri E Eviscerate, which revives her pack, is used, look for a chance to clear the pack with the area damage from LeBlanc W Distortion. If you have pushed the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, join a fight in a side lane or the jungle.
Then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return to a safe spot.

Engage while Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate are down, before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and use LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to cut off her escape. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is still available, retreat within the short LeBlanc W Distortion return window.
Early on, use LeBlanc's range advantage to poke Naafiri. Later, a counterattack is dangerous if LeBlanc cannot kill in one burst, so prioritize chances to pick off enemies walking alone.

Do not enter from the front first. Once the fight starts and the enemy focuses on your tank, pick a target and engage from the side. Target one backline enemy, then get out with LeBlanc W Distortion. Watch for Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit and do not walk alone away from your team. If an ally has just died, retreat to avoid being picked off in succession.

texts: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, follow-up damage is likely. If the first spell hits, use LeBlanc W Distortion to reposition immediately and dodge the second. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on your maximum health, so leave its telegraphed area.
Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Prioritize magic resistance because most of Hwei's damage is magic.

After Hwei uses E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion. Deal brief damage, check which counterattack spells Hwei still has, then escape by recasting W to return.

While Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, don't engage first with LeBlanc W Distortion. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you can't push the lane, don't leave.
Once Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and stay in range to keep the chain connected.

Hwei has no mobility spell, so engage with LeBlanc W Distortion while Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. If E is available, Hwei can cancel your engage or root you, so wait. Before going in, make sure your W return point is safe.

Early on, withstand Hwei's magic damage with magic resistance and take short trades. Later, the enemy's magic resistance and vision can keep you from killing them in one burst and leave you open to a counterattack, so prioritize opportunities to catch someone out.

Don't engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your team's tank, approach from the side. When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, use LeBlanc W Distortion on one backline target, then recast W to escape. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch an enemy alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

For Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the follow-up chains are more dangerous than the first dash. Save LeBlanc W Distortion to dodge the chains, and immediately leave the crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash. Don't delay finishing off a low-health Sylas, since Sylas W Kingslayer can restore a large amount of health.
Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Trade briefly after Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, before it comes back. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion, watch whether Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, then escape by recasting W to return.
Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, then roam. If you can't push the lane, don't leave.

When Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the chain connected. As soon as it roots him, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to detonate the mark. Before engaging, make sure your return point is safe, and recast LeBlanc W Distortion in time to return.

After dodging the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, engage before the ability comes back. If Sylas W Kingslayer is also available, he can still escape with another mobility spell, so check for it before going in with LeBlanc W Distortion. Get out before LeBlanc W Distortion's return window ends.
Later, when the enemy has magic resistance and vision, killing them in one burst becomes difficult, so avoid forcing an engage.

Right after Sylas dives in with E Abscond / Abduct, catch him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or R Mimic and kill him before he can heal with W Kingslayer. When engaging yourself, wait until the fight starts, target one backline enemy from the side, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Also look for a chance to catch an enemy alone without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch which direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and also move out of its return path. If Ekko's afterimage is visible, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't chase recklessly even if he's low.
Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence's area and trade briefly right after Ekko E Phase Dive is down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and look for a chance to root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Before going in, make sure LeBlanc W Distortion's return point is safe.

Avoid extended trades until the enemy's key abilities are down. Repeat short trades by engaging with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recasting it to return. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice to push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you can't push the lane, don't leave.

If Ekko E Phase Dive is down, land LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep it connected; when it roots him, follow with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. To try for another root, use LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence's marked area and engage after Ekko E Phase Dive is down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don't chase deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. When both mobility spells are down, approach with LeBlanc W Distortion and connect LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

Don't engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your team's tank, choose a target and approach from the side. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch an enemy alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

After Naafiri E Eviscerate, which revives the pack, is down, look for a chance to clear the pack with LeBlanc W Distortion's area damage. If you've pushed the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, join a side lane or jungle skirmish.
Then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return to a safe spot.

Engage during the window when Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate are down, and before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and use LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to block her escape route. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is still available, retreat within the short window when you can recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return.

Don't engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your team's tank, choose a target and approach from the side. After an ally dies, retreat so you don't get picked off in succession.

texts: 治疗量根据完成击杀或助攻时你已损失的生命值计算。（如果在延迟期间再次完成击杀或助攻，所有尚未生效的凯旋治疗量都会按最新一次击杀或助攻发生时你已损失的生命值重新计算。）
[备注] 被护盾完全抵消的伤害不会打断回城。
离开河道后，额外移动速度会在 1 秒内逐渐衰减，而额外属性会立即消失。
净化会移除引燃的持续伤害和暴露视野效果，但治疗效果降低的减益仍会持续。

多个携带爆破的玩家可以对同一座防御塔叠加层数，每位玩家的层数分别计算。
完成击杀或助攻时，使用能量的英雄会回复 30 能量；慎回复 60 能量，阿卡丽在霞阵生效期间回复 42 能量。
获得该效果提供的额外生命值不会增加使用者的当前生命值。
近战英雄约需触发 16 次才能使治疗量增加 1，远程英雄约需触发 43 次。

texts: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals area damage, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid it. If you are hit by the flame circle from Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, leave the circle before it detonates a moment later. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away to break the tether before it roots you.
Build magic resistance first against Karma's main damage. If the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra is strong, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.

After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy to close in when Karma steps forward for a last hit. If the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra is active, delay your engage until it expires. Once you start a trade, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then back off.
Talon has short range, so avoid stepping forward first and chip away at Karma's health with Talon W Rake. Do not use it so often that you lack mana for a kill opportunity.

For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then hit both the outward and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then follow with a basic attack.

Engaging while Karma W Focused Resolve is down reduces the risk of being rooted. Wait for the movement speed boost from Karma E Inspire and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra to expire, then close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon's burst and roaming become stronger. Push the wave, then cross walls with Talon E Assassin's Path to influence the side lanes. Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.

Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has expired. Pick one target and focus your abilities on them. If a frontal engage is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and target the backline. If possible, use Talon R Shadow Assault to get out.

The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but the follow-up chain knocks you up and leaves you open to a combo if it hits. Time Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to dodge the chain, rather than the first dash. The intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so leave it immediately even if the first hit only grazes you.

Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer. The bleed from Talon P Blade's End deals damage over time, making it easy to keep Grievous Wounds applied. Magic resistance, rather than armor, counters Sylas's main damage.

When Sylas steps forward for a last hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy for a short trade. Land both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then back off. If Sylas W Kingslayer is available, be careful not to chip him down and delay the finishing blow.
Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana, so do not use it excessively. After pushing the wave, check vision as you roam.

For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then throw Talon W Rake at close range to land both strikes. Follow with one basic attack to trigger the bleed from Talon P Blade's End. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then use a basic attack.

Your opening to engage comes after you dodge the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer is also down. Use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to close the gap. The chain can interrupt Talon E Assassin's Path, so save it until you have dodged the chain, and keep Talon R Shadow Assault available to escape.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon's roaming and burst become stronger. Use Talon E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage in a side lane. Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.

Sylas is most vulnerable just after engaging with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. Focus him with your team then. When engaging yourself, wait until the enemy has used their crowd control on your allies, then flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on one target. It is safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.

texts: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals area damage, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid being hit. If you are hit by the fire circle from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, move out of it before it explodes a moment later. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before you are rooted.
Build magic resistance early against Karma’s primary damage. If the healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W is substantial, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.

After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Karma steps forward to last-hit. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, delay your engage until it expires. Once you start a trade, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack and disengage.
Talon has short range, so don’t step forward first. Use Talon W Rake to chip away at her health. Don’t spam W and run out of mana you need for a kill opportunity.

When you can land the full combo, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then hit with both the outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. For a quick trade, cast Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with a basic attack.

Engaging during the window after Karma W Focused Resolve is down lowers the risk of being caught by its root. Wait for the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E to expire, then close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to disengage.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your burst and roaming power increase. Push the wave, then use Talon E Assassin's Path to cross a wall and make a play on a side lane. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes longer, so keep up the pressure while ahead.

Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E has expired. Pick one target and focus your abilities on them. If a direct engage is difficult, flank the backline with Talon E Assassin's Path. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.

The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but if you are hit by the follow-up chains, you are knocked up and take a combo. Time Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to dodge the chains, not the first dash. The intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so move away immediately even if you are only clipped by the initial hit.

Slot Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer. The bleed from Talon P Blade's End deals damage over time, making it easy to keep healing reduction applied. The resistance that counters Sylas’s main damage is magic resistance, not armor.

When Sylas steps forward to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy for a short trade. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack and disengage. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, be careful not to leave him low and delay the finish.
Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana, so don’t spam it. After pushing the wave, check vision and roam.

When you can land the full combo, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then cast Talon W Rake at close range to land both hits. Follow with one basic attack to trigger the bleed from Talon P Blade's End. For a quick trade, cast Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with a basic attack.

Avoid the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Once Sylas W Kingslayer is also down, that’s your chance to engage. Close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or use Talon E Assassin's Path to bridge the gap. Talon E Assassin's Path can be interrupted by the chains, so save it until you’ve dodged them. Keep Talon R Shadow Assault available as an escape.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst become stronger, so use Talon E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage on a side lane. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes longer, so keep up the pressure while ahead.

Sylas is at his weakest just after engaging with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer, so focus him with your allies. When engaging directly, wait until the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, then flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on one target. It’s safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
